sql:type:$extension.bioseq_aligner_optio.summary: Aligner settings for one mmsearch call. NULL fields use the corresponding session setting.

fields.name: kmer_size
fields.description: Number of bases in each k-mer considered for a minimizer. NULL uses the session value of bioseq.aligner.minimizer.kmer_size.

fields.name: window_size
fields.description: Number of consecutive, k-mers in a  minimizer window. NULL uses the session value of bioseq.aligner.minimizer.window_size.

fields.name: max_gap
fields.description: Maximum diqtance between anchors that chaining can join. NULL uses the session value of bioseq.aligner.chaining.maximum_gap.

fields.name: max_gap_ref
fields.description: Store a reference-gap override in the request. The current chaining code uses maximum_gap for both sequences. NULL uses the session value of bioseq.aligner.chaining.maximum_reference_gap.

fields.name: bandwidth
fields.description: Sets the chaining and alignment bandwidth. NULL uses the session value of bioseq.aligner.chaining.bandwidth.

fields.name: bandwidth_long
fields.description: Store a long-join bandwidth in the request. The current pipeline does not use this setting. NULL uses the session value of bioseq.aligner.chaining.long_join_bandwidth.

fields.name: max_chain_skip
fields.description: Stop searching earlier anchors after this many unhelpful candidates. NULL uses the session value of bioseq.aligner.chaining.maximum_skipped_anchors.

fields.name: max_chain_iter
fields.description: Limits predecessors examined for each anchor. NULL uses the session value of bioseq.aligner.chaining.maximum_predecessors.

fields.name: min_seed_count
fields.description: Sets the minimum seed count accepted for a chain. NULL uses the session value of bioseq.aligner.chaining.minimum_seed_count.

fields.name: min_chain_score
fields.description: Sets the minimum accepted chain score. NULL uses the session value of bioseq.aligner.chaining.minimum_score.

fields.name: chain_gap_scale
fields.description: Scales the chaining gap penalty. NULL uses the session value of bioseq.aligner.chaining.gap_penalty_scale.

fields.name: chain_skip_scale
fields.description: Scales the chaining skip penalty. NULL uses the session value of bioseq.aligner.chaining.skip_penalty_scale.

fields.name: mask_level
fields.description: Required query overlap for assigning an alignment to a primary. The  comparison also accounts for query bases left uncovered by primaries. NULL uses the session value of bioseq.aligner.secondary.overlap_threshold.

fields.name: mask_len
fields.description: Maximum uncovered query length allowed for a secondary alignment. NULL uses the session value of bioseq.aligner.secondary.uncovered_length_limit.

fields.name: pri_ratio
fields.description: Score ratio used to keep a secondary relative to its primary. A secondary can also pass within the allowed absolute score difference. Zero disables the CPU secondary filter. NULL uses the session value of bioseq.aligner.secondary.score_ratio_threshold.

fields.name: best_n
fields.description: Maximum secondary alignments kept across one query. NULL uses the session value of bioseq.aligner.secondary.maximum_count.

fields.name: match_score
fields.description: Sets the alignment match score. NULL uses the session value of bioseq.aligner.scoring.match_score.

fields.name: mismatch_pen
fields.description: Sets the alignment mismatch penalty. NULL uses the session value of bioseq.aligner.scoring.mismatch_penalty.

fields.name: gap_open1
fields.description: Sets the short-gap opening penalty. NULL uses the session value of bioseq.aligner.scoring.short_gap_open_penalty.

fields.name: gap_ext1
fields.description: Sets the short-gap extension penalty. NULL uses the session value of bioseq.aligner.scoring.short_gap_extension_penalty.

fields.name: gap_open2
fields.description: Sets the long-gap opening penalty. NULL uses the session value of bioseq.aligner.scoring.long_gap_open_penalty.

fields.name: gap_ext2
fields.description: Sets the long-gap extension penalty. NULL uses the session value of bioseq.aligner.scoring.long_gap_extension_penalty.

fields.name: sc_ambi
fields.description: Sets the penalty for ambiguous bases. NULL uses the session value of bioseq.aligner.scoring.ambiguous_base_penalty.

fields.name: zdrop
fields.description: Stop  extension when its score falls too far below the besw score. Z-drop adjusts the comparison for gaps. Negative one disables it. NULL uses the session value of bioseq.aligner.scoring.z_drop_threshold.

fields.name: end_bonus
fields.description: Bonus for an alignment that reaches the query end. Negative one disables the bonus. NULL uses the session value of bioseq.aligner.scoring.end_bonus.

fields.name: max_occ
fields.description: Ignore minimizers with more target occurrences than this limit. NULL uses the session value of bioseq.aligner.seeding.maximum_occurrence.

fields.name: mid_occ
fields.description: Store an intermediate occurrence threshold in the request. The current seeding code uses maximum_occurrence instead. NULL uses the session value of bioseq.aligner.seeding.intermediate_occurrence_threshold.

fields.name: block_min_size
fields.description: Sets the minimum block size used by the block aligner. NULL uses the session value of bioseq.aligner.block_alignment.minimum_block_size.

fields.name: block_max_size
fields.description: Sets the maximum block size used by the block aligner. NULL uses the session value of bioseq.aligner.block_alignment.maximum_block_size.

fields.name: chaining_algorithm
fields.description: Selects the seed-anchor chaining algorithm. Values: 0 scalar_minimap2, 1 simd_minimap2, 2 range_minimum_query, 3 vulkan_tiled_dynamic_programming. NULL uses the session value of bioseq.aligner.chaining.algorithm.

fields.name: base_alignment_algorithm
fields.description: Selects the base-level alignment algorithm. Values: 0 ksw2, 1 block_aligner. NULL uses the session value of bioseq.aligner.base_alignment.algorithm.

fields.name: minimizer_algorithm
fields.description: Selects the minimizer extraction algorithm. Values: 0 scalar, 1 simd_minimap2_reference, 2 two_stack_nthash, 3 vulkan_minimap_integer, 4 bounded_nthash_simd. NULL uses the session value of bioseq.aligner.minimizer.algorithm.

fields.name: vulkan_enabled
fields.description: Allows execution through Vulkan-backed algorithms. NULL uses the session value of bioseq.aligner.vulkan.enabled.

fields.name: vulkan_seed_hits_enabled
fields.description: Enables Vulkan seed-hit lookup. NULL uses the session value of bioseq.aligner.vulkan.seed_lookup.enabled.

fields.name: vulkan_index_cache_enabled
fields.description: Keep uploaded target indexes for later GPU lookups. NULL uses the session value of bioseq.aligner.vulkan.index_cache.enabled.

fields.name: index_read_requirement
fields.description: Sets the requirement for using a stored minimizer index. Values: 0 allows a compatible stored index or an index built for the query; 1 requires the persisted index to be absent; 2 requires a compatible persisted index. NULL keeps the planner's default index-read requirement.
